intro: In Stormwind, Furen Longbeard seeks help testing new armor. An aspiring warrior gathers spider fangs, chimaera horns, and phlogiston so the master smith can forge fire-hardened mail. Furen gives the finished armor to the warrior and promises to share what he learned with Alliance smiths.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here's your armor, friend. This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard!
And I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day!
I'm going to send what I learned to other blacksmiths of the Alliance.
I'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
